title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region residency & audit hardening
author: Elena Martinez
description:
Motivation: enforce KMS key regional residency constraints for RBAC v2 resources and tighten audit logging for cross-region KMS operations. This prevents accidental data egress when tenants pin keys to specific regions and improves forensic traceability for compliance audits. Changes implement an enforcement path (opt-in by default) plus an audit-only mode for staged rollout.

Summary of changes: added a KMS region residency enforcement module, extended RBAC v2 policy schema with kms_region constraint, enhanced audit logging to include KMS key region metadata and decision reasons, added DB migration to persist region pins, and added integration/unit tests. Introduced a feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce` controlled via config and Console rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Policy schema update for RBAC v2 (validation + backward compatibility)
- [x] Enforcement path (policy evaluator + request-time check)
- [x] Audit-only mode and structured audit fields for KMS events
- [x] DB migration to store kms_region pins and indexes
- [x] Integration tests covering allowed/blocked flows
- [x] Docs + migration notes + operator runbook

Testing: unit + integration tests added under tests/integration covering create/update policy flows, key attach/detach, and cross-region access attempts. Ran full CI (lint/unit/integration/e2e/security-scan). Performed a canary rollout in staging for two weeks; telemetry shows no unexpected denials.

Rollout notes: default deployment is audit-only. Ops can enable enforcement via Console or env flag for orgs that have completed migration. Backwards compatibility maintained: policies without kms_region remain permissive. For enforcement mode, operators should run a 72h audit-only window to resolve violations before flipping the flag.

Migration: added migration `20240514_add_kms_region_pinning.sql` to add `kms_region` column and index. Migration is idempotent and guarded by feature flag.

Related: ENG-4521, SEC-998, SUP-2143.

Impact: improves compliance posture for customers requiring data residency guarantees and provides clearer audit trails for internal security investigations. No user-facing API breaking changes when audit-only mode is used.
